description: List Canton Network ecosystem projects (DeFi protocols, wallets, custody, infrastructure, NaaS, etc.) from the curated canton.wiki catalog. Filter by category or free-text query. Returns name, category, description and URL: a static directory of who-builds-on-Canton, not live on-chain/TVL data (use get_token_market for live DeFi TVL). Canton-only.

limit.description: How many projects to return. Default 30, max 100. The response states the full count.

liveness.description: Restrict to projects whose site last responded this way to CCPEDIA's daily probe. Omit for all of them; every row is labelled either way.

offset.description: Skip this many before returning, for paging past the limit. The response states the full count and echoes the offset used.

name: list_ecosystem_projects
